app.name: Diary
app.tagline: Your personal space for thoughts, people and memories

update.needsInstall: Update v{{version}} needs a new app install

dailyReminderBodies: Today is still blank. Feels a little disrespectful to the day, honestly.
Your diary is gathering dust. One sentence fixes that.
Your diary is starting to think you've moved on.
Somewhere, a future you is hoping you wrote this down.
This notification has more words than today's diary.
The page isn't getting any less blank.
Quick reminder: today doesn't write itself.
Today happened. Your diary respectfully disagrees.
Five minutes from now, you could have a diary entry instead of this notification.
Your streak is counting on you. No pressure.
birthdayBodies: {{name}} only turns this age once. Probably a good moment to say hi.
Cake, candles, {{name}} — today has all three. Join in.
One message from you could make {{name}}'s whole day.
{{name}} is expecting confetti emojis at minimum.
It's {{name}}'s big day. Don't be the friend who forgot.
Drop {{name}} a happy birthday before someone else beats you to it.

descriptions.1: Life-changing events like getting married, a new job, moving abroad
descriptions.2: Memorable personal developments, experiences and achievements
descriptions.3: Meaningful moments and solid milestones that make a week special
descriptions.4: Deviations from the norm, practical skill-building or small goals

language.title: Welcome to your diary
language.lede: First, a quick check — is this the right language?

writing.title: Write down what happened
writing.lede: An entry is one line about your day. Add a person or topic to give it more context.
writing.person: Type @ and a name to link someone. The entry becomes a story you can come back to and share with them later.
writing.tag: Type # to tag a topic, so everything about it stays connected and easy to find.
writing.subEntries: Add sub-entries underneath to keep the details close to the moment they belong to.

importance.title: How much did it matter?
importance.lede: Give each entry a level of importance. More important moments stay relevant for longer.

people.title: Things worth telling
people.lede: Anyone you mention gets a list of entries that might interest them, so you always have something to pick up the conversation with.
people.decay: The list naturally gets shorter over time. Less important moments fade sooner, while meaningful ones stay around longer. Mark something as said and it steps aside.

reminders.title: A nudge at the end of the day
reminders.lede: Get one quiet reminder if you haven't written anything yet. You can change this any time in Settings.

threads.title: One topic, many days
threads.lede: A thread groups entries about the same project or subject into a single story you can look back on — or catch someone up on all at once.

plugins.title: Extend your diary with Plugins
plugins.lede: Optional features like habit tracking or period logging are built as plugins. Activate them anytime from Settings.
plugins.settingsNote: Turn plugins on or off anytime in Settings → Plugins.

demo.entryCollaboration: We talked about a possible collaboration between our teams
demo.threadFeature: Added the threads feature to the Diary #{{tag}}

diary.title: Diary
diary.noEntriesDescription: Start writing your thoughts for this day
diary.willBeSaidTo: Will be marked as said to
diary.deleteConfirmDescription: This will also delete its sub-entries. This cannot be undone.

people.title: People
people.name: Name
people.tagsDescription: Entries sharing these tags become talking points for this person
people.noPeopleDescription: Add the people you talk to and the diary will suggest what to tell them.
people.noTalkingPointsDescription: New entries that mention {{name}} or share their tags will appear here.
people.noMemoriesDescription: Important entries that mention {{name}} will resurface here after {{months}} months.
people.loadFailedDescription: This person couldn't be loaded. Nothing has been lost — try again.
people.deleteConfirmDescription: Entries will be kept, but every mention, said-mark and hidden-mark of this person will be removed.
people.duplicate_name: A person with that name already exists
people.checkupRemindersDescription: Get an alert on this person's profile when it's been a while since you last talked.
people.checkupDueDescription: It's been a while since you last marked something as said to them.
checkupBodies: It's been {{days}} days. {{name}} is about to hire a medium to contact you.
It's been {{days}} days since you last talked to {{name}}. They might be wondering if you changed phones.
{{name}} hasn't heard from you in {{days}} days. Time to prove you're not a ghost.
Plot twist: {{name}} still exists outside your group chats. It's been {{days}} days!
Breaking news: {{name}} is still waiting for you to say hi. It's been {{days}} days.
Your friendship with {{name}} isn't extinct yet, but it's been {{days}} days. Go water it.
{{name}} called. Just kidding, they didn't, because it's been {{days}} days since you reached out first.
Gentle nudge: {{name}} is a real person who exists outside your notifications. {{days}} days and counting.
It's been {{days}} days. {{name}} is starting to suspect they've been replaced by a Tamagotchi you forgot to feed.
Friendly reminder: {{name}} misses you, or at least you should assume so after {{days}} days of silence.
{{days}} days of radio silence with {{name}}. Send a meme, a hello, anything.
Achievement unlocked: {{days}} days without talking to {{name}}. Please don't go for the next tier.
{{name}} is patiently waiting. It's been {{days}} days — maybe say something before it becomes a milestone.
people.phoneIncomplete: Not in international format — add the country code so WhatsApp and calls work.
people.wechatQrDescription: Scan this from your phone to get the ID, then paste it into WeChat's search. WeChat does not allow opening a chat directly from a link.
people.aliasesDescription: Nicknames this person also answers to. Used by @mentions and voice dictation.
people.birthdayYearOptional: The year is optional — leave it blank if you don't know it.
people.wechatCopiedHint: WeChat ID copied — paste it into WeChat's search to open the chat.
people.wechatSearchHint: Search for {{id}} in WeChat to open the chat.
people.eventTitlePlaceholder: Trip to Lisbon, driving test, surgery…
people.eventEndHint: Leave the end date blank for a single-day event.
people.eventEndBeforeStart: The end date cannot be before the start date.
people.eventNotesPlaceholder: Anything worth remembering to ask about…
people.noEventsDescription: Add things that happen to {{name}} and the diary will remind you to ask how they went.
people.eventFollowUpDescription: These finished recently — ask {{name}} how they went.
people.eventDeleteConfirmDescription: This removes the event and its reminder. It cannot be undone.

tags.title: Tags
tags.name: Name
tags.noTagsDescription: Tags connect entries to people. Create a few to get started.
tags.deleteConfirmDescription: It will be removed from all entries and people that use it.
tags.duplicate_name: A tag with that name already exists

threads.title: Threads
threads.name: Name
threads.noThreadsDescription: A thread groups entries about one ongoing topic — a project, a move, your research — so you can catch someone up on all of it at once.
threads.deleteConfirmDescription: The entries themselves are kept, along with everything already marked as said — they just stop being grouped.
threads.limitReached: An entry can belong to at most {{count}} threads.

search.title: Search
search.noResultsDescription: Try different words or fewer filters.

settings.title: Settings

general.title: General
general.languageOfflineHint: Languages you haven't used on this device yet need a connection the first time.
general.languageDownloadFailed: Couldn't download that language. Try again when you're connected.
general.quietNotificationsDescription: Stop confirming everyday actions like saving an entry. Errors, and confirmations for settings, backups and imports, still appear. This is not about the reminders your phone sends.
general.hapticsDescription: A light tick when you press something.
general.importanceShapesDescription: Give each level its own shape as well as its colour, so the dots stay apart when the colours don’t.

reminders.title: Reminders
reminders.description: The notifications this device sends. They stay on this device, and their times are local to it.
reminders.blocked: Notifications are turned off for Diary in your phone's settings, so none of these can be sent.
reminders.dailyDescription: Only on days you haven't written anything.
reminders.birthdaysDescription: On the morning of the day itself, for everyone with a birthday saved.
reminders.checkupsDescription: When it's been a while since you last told someone anything. Several at once arrive as one.
reminders.quietHoursDescription: Reminders that have no time of their own wait until the morning instead of arriving overnight. The times you set above are never delayed.
reminders.exactAlarmsDescription: Without this, Android may deliver reminders late — sometimes hours late.

entries.title: New entries
entries.autoSaid: Mentioning someone marks it as told
entries.autoSaidDescription: Only sets how the tick box starts; you can always change it before saving.
entries.expandedDescription: Whether an entry's sub-entries start unfolded.
entries.entityLinksDescription: @mentions and #tags inside an entry open that person, or the entries carrying that tag. Off leaves them as highlighted text.

decay.title: Talking point decay
decay.description: How long entries of each importance stay relevant as talking points. The value is a half-life in days: after that many days an entry has half its initial score, and it disappears once the score falls below the cutoff.

memories.title: Memories
memories.description: Entries that directly mention a person come back as shared memories once they are old enough.
memories.thresholdDescription: Only entries at this importance or higher become memories

broadcast.title: Broadcast to everyone
broadcast.description: Some entries can be suggested as talking points for every person, not just those they mention or share a tag with.
broadcast.lifeChangingDescription: Suggest every "Life-changing" entry to everyone, regardless of match.
broadcast.tagsDescription: Entries with these tags are suggested to everyone regardless of match.

checkups.title: Checkup reminders
checkups.description: Default checkup interval inherited by newly created people. Each person can override or disable it from their profile.

ai.title: AI assistant
ai.description: Record a voice note and let AI turn it into diary entry suggestions you can review before saving. Groq is required for transcription; adding an OpenRouter or Cerebras key switches the suggestion step to a stronger model instead of Groq's.
ai.signInRequired: Sign in to use AI features — voice transcription and suggestions run on the server.
ai.apiKeyHint: Required for voice transcription. Free to get, used only to call Groq directly from this device. Get one at
ai.forceEnglishAIEvents: Force AI dictation suggestions to English
ai.forceEnglishAIEventsDescription: When enabled, entries created from voice dictation are written in English even if you speak another language.
ai.openRouterApiKeyHint: When set, used instead of Groq to turn transcripts into entry suggestions. Free to get, used only to call OpenRouter directly from this device. Get one at
ai.cerebrasApiKeyHint: When set, used instead of Groq to turn transcripts into entry suggestions. Free to get, used only to call Cerebras directly from this device. Get one at

settings.accountLocalOnlyDescription: Your data stays on this device only. Sign in to back it up and sync across devices.

data.title: Data
data.description: Back up everything to a file, restore from a previous backup, or export part of your diary as Markdown for an AI agent to analyze.
data.invalidFile: That file isn't a valid backup
data.exportMarkdownDescription: Export entries or a person's briefing as a Markdown file, for pasting into an AI agent.
data.exportOmits: API keys are stored on the server and never reach this device, so they are not in the file. Theme, reminders and the app lock are settings of this device and are not included either.
data.telemetryDescription: Anonymous errors and usage counts, so problems on this device can be found and fixed. Never entry text, names or notes.

deleteAccount.actionDescription: Erase your diary and your account from the server. This cannot be undone, so export a backup first if there is anything you want to keep.
deleteAccount.title: Delete everything?
deleteAccount.description: This erases your diary from the server and closes your account. There is no way to undo it and no copy kept.
deleteAccount.bulletContent: Every entry, person, tag and thread is deleted, along with your settings.
deleteAccount.bulletAccount: Your account is closed. Signing in with Google again would start an empty diary.
deleteAccount.bulletDevices: Your other devices keep whatever they have already downloaded until you sign out on them.
deleteAccount.exportFirstDescription: Saves everything to a JSON file you can import into a new diary later. Strongly recommended.
deleteAccount.lockDescription: Confirm it is you before the diary is erased.
deleteAccount.signInDescription: Sign in with Google again to confirm it is you.
deleteAccount.signInWhy: Your last sign-in is too old for something this final. Nothing has been deleted.
deleteAccount.resumedDescription: Signed in again. This is the last step, and it cannot be undone.
deleteAccount.signInFailed: Couldn't confirm it was you. Nothing was deleted.
deleteAccount.failed: Couldn't delete your data. Nothing was deleted — please try again.
deleteAccount.needsConnection: Needs a connection to the server. Try again once you are back online.

markdownExport.title: Export as Markdown
markdownExport.description: Choose what to include — the file is meant to be handed to an AI agent, not read as a backup.

option.saidTimeline: Timeline of what's been said to them
option.unsaidCount: Count of things not yet said

settings.resetDefaultsConfirmDescription: The decay, memory, broadcast, checkup and AI settings all go back to their default values. Your entries, people and tags are not affected.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.wifiOnlyDescription: Changes keep saving on this device and go up the next time you're on Wi-Fi. The diary is text, so this rarely saves much.
advanced.hidePausedStatusDescription: Queued changes still sync as soon as you are on Wi-Fi.
advanced.nestingDepthDescription: Levels below a top-level entry. Lowering it doesn't touch entries that are already deeper.

settings.signOutPendingTitle_one: Sign out with {{count}} change not yet saved to your account?
settings.signOutPendingTitle_other: Sign out with {{count}} changes not yet saved to your account?
settings.signOutPendingDescription: Signing out clears this device. Anything still waiting to sync will be lost for good. Reconnect and let it finish first if you want to keep it.

plugins.title: Plugins
plugins.description: Optional features you can switch on. Enabling one applies to every device.
plugins.hasData_one: Off — {{count}} entry saved on this account
plugins.hasData_other: Off — {{count}} entries saved on this account

errors.reauth_required: Sign in again to confirm it is you.

crash.title: Something went wrong
crash.description: The app hit an unexpected error. Your entries are safe on this device.

person.duplicate_name: A person with that name already exists

tag.duplicate_name: A tag with that name already exists

thread.duplicate_name: A thread with that name already exists

ai.reviewDescription: Edit or remove anything before adding these to your diary.
ai.reviewDescriptionSub: Edit or remove anything before adding these under “{{parent}}”.
ai.subEntryDescription: Recording — describe the details to add under “{{parent}}”.
ai.empty: Nothing to suggest from that recording
ai.invalid_key: Your LLM API key looks invalid
ai.rate_limited: LLM rate limit reached, try again shortly
ai.timeout: The LLM took too long to respond
ai.no_key: Add a Groq API key in settings first
ai.recording_too_large: That recording is too long to upload
ai.too_many_requests: Too many AI requests — give it a minute
ai.no_submission: Couldn't get a result from the assistant
ai.signInRequiredForVoice: Sign in to use voice entries.

import.title: Import from contacts
import.nativeOnly: Contacts can only be imported from the Android app.
import.noPermissionDescription: Grant the contacts permission in system settings to import people from your address book.
import.summaryNew: {{count}} contact will be added as a new person.
import.summaryNew_other: {{count}} contacts will be added as new people.
import.conflictDuplicate: “{{name}}” already exists. Two people can’t share a name.
import.conflictContainment: Looks similar to “{{name}}” — they might be the same person.

importBackup.title: Import backup
importBackup.noFileDescription: Go back to Settings and choose a backup file to import.
importBackup.conflictDuplicate: “{{name}}” already exists. Two can’t share a name.
importBackup.conflictEntryDuplicate: This exact entry is already on this device.
importBackup.conflictContainment: Looks similar to “{{name}}” — might be the same person.
importBackup.done: Tags: {{tagsCreated}} added, {{tagsMerged}} merged. Threads: {{threadsCreated}} added, {{threadsMerged}} merged. People: {{peopleCreated}} added, {{peopleMerged}} merged. Entries: {{entriesCreated}} added, {{entriesMerged}} overwritten.
importBackup.orphaned: {{count}} entry moved to the top level because its parent wasn't imported.
importBackup.orphaned_other: {{count}} entries moved to the top level because their parent wasn't imported.
importBackup.entriesSkipped: {{count}} entry was already here and was left as it is.
importBackup.entriesSkipped_other: {{count}} entries were already here and were left as they are.
importBackup.allClearDescription: Everything in this backup is new to this device, so nothing will be overwritten or merged. Import it whenever you are ready.
importBackup.syncingHint: Keep this page open until the upload finishes.
importBackup.syncLater: Saved on this device. It will finish uploading once you are back online.

security.title: Security
security.description: A passcode in front of the diary on this device. It stays on when you sign out, and applies whether or not you use an account.
security.requirePasscodeDescription: Ask for it before the diary opens.
security.mismatch: The two passcodes do not match.
security.noRecoveryWarning: There is no way to recover this passcode. Forgetting it means reinstalling the app and signing in again.
security.lockedDescription: Enter your passcode to carry on.
security.biometricsDescription: Use your fingerprint or face instead of typing the passcode.

dnd.lifted: Picked up. Use the arrow keys to move it, space to drop, escape to cancel.
